title: The yellow umbrella
original:
I left my yellow umbrella on the third hook beside the door. One spoke is bent, so it never folds quite flat.

I made tea in the cracked blue cup. I turn the crack toward the wall so I do not have to look at it. The spare key is still under the sugar tin.

I put a folded towel under the drips before bed.

edits.target: I put a folded towel under the drips before bed.
edits.text: I gently touched the bent spoke.

title: The empty hook
original:
The spare key was gone from under the sugar tin. I will ask the caretaker tomorrow.

I set two places at the kitchen table without thinking. I put the extra spoon away, but left the second saucer out.

The hallway floor was dry when I got home. I checked my bag twice. The third hook beside the door was empty.

edits.text: I examined the bent spoke of the umbrella.

title: The locked cupboard
original:
The caretaker says nobody came upstairs. I found the spare key on the second saucer this morning. There was a ring of tea around it.

The umbrella was hanging beside the door again. I carried it straight to the hallway cupboard.

I locked the cupboard with the umbrella inside. I slid the key under the door for the caretaker to collect.
